notes:
Summary: Lighthouse builds a JetBrains (IntelliJ/PyCharm) plugin that provides on-device code completions powered by a local index + remote model fallback. They prioritize sub-50ms incremental completions when the index is warm and <150ms cold-path streaming when routed to hosted model.

Key technical ask: Java/Kotlin SDK hooks for local index sync, websocket streaming API for low-latency token stream, ability to pin model versions per workspace, and a simple quantized local-model workflow (still evaluating whether Redwood-hosted or fully on-prem). They want KV/prefix cache semantics exposed to the plugin so we can reuse token caches across editor sessions.

Security & compliance: Must support SSO (SAML), org-level audit logs, KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency for several customers. Legal asked for explicit data residency clauses and a sanitized telemetry opt-out.

Commercials: Interested in Dedicated for scale (internal CI + many dev seats) and Private for enterprise customers. Open to hosted during beta to reduce ops overhead. ARR expected if POC successful: $50k–$150k annually.

Quotes from meetings: "Primary metric is completion latency — devs will churn if suggestions lag >80ms"; "Model pinning per project is a must for reproducibility."

Integration notes: POC will run on two internal teams (backend Kotlin and Python SDK team). Need a quickstart Java example, streaming sample, and a mini workload that simulates 100 concurrent dev sessions with warm local indexes.

Links: Fireflies FF-20260302-0973 (POC kickoff), Drive: pricing deck + security FAQ. Jira INF-4521 is the perf ticket (requested top-level batching knobs).
